obligations.behavior: mem_guard is optional and additive; level, admit and concurrency_factor are byte-identical with or without it; clients that ignore unknown fields see no change.
obligations.source_text: The state doc gains an optional mem_guard object (action, armed, last_kill {t, pid, comm, rss_mib}); level, admit and concurrency_factor stay thermal-only.

obligations.behavior: every new row type carries an 'event' key; tick rows gain only an optional 'top' list; history.py and report() parse all existing and new rows without error.
obligations.source_text: New record rows carry an 'event' key (memory_kill, memory_would_kill, oom_kill) and tick rows gain only an optional 'top' field, so the fleet view's history reader ignores them unchanged.

obligations.behavior: keys are <prefix>/<machine>/<boot_id>/events/<utc>-<kind>.json, <prefix>/<machine>/<boot_id>/blackbox.jsonl.gz and <prefix>/<machine>/<boot_id>/postmortem.json; ship fetch reads exactly this layout.
obligations.source_text: Off-box shipping to S3 with a stdlib SigV4 signer (hmac, hashlib, urllib.request PUT; no boto3): on a kill or OOM event, PUT the event JSON immediately; every 60 s (every 10 s while available < 20%) PUT a rolling black box (last 10 min of records, gzipped) to `<prefix>/<host>/<boot_id>/blackbox.jsonl.gz`; on start after an unclean boot, PUT a postmortem. Runs in its own thread with a bounded queue; failures spool to disk and retry, never blocking the guard.

obligations.behavior: path-style PUT/GET/ListObjectsV2 signed with SigV4 (UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD never used; x-amz-content-sha256 is the payload hash), region configurable incl. 'auto'; the same requests work against all three.
obligations.source_text: Credentials and target from config: [ship] bucket, region, prefix, optional profile (read from ~/.aws/credentials and ~/.aws/config via configparser) or AWS_* environment variables, optional endpoint for S3-compatible stores. Secrets are never written to records, logs or uploads.

obligations.behavior: only processes of the daemon's own uid, never protected or below min_victim_mib, pinned by pidfd, SIGKILL only, within the kill budget; every kill and would-kill writes its event before the next poll.
obligations.source_text: Victim: the own-uid process whose RSS grew most over the last ~10 s, with RSS >= min_victim_mib (default 2048), skipping a protect list (the governor and its parent chain, pid 1, systemd, sshd, gnome-shell, Xwayland, tailscaled, dockerd, containerd and any [memory] protect entries). Sent SIGKILL (no grace: at 1.2 GB/s a SIGTERM grace period costs GBs). os.kill and proc_root are injected for tests.

obligations.behavior: unknown keys and out-of-range values are rejected by config check and by a live reload (the running config stays in force), like every other section.
obligations.source_text: Config: new strict [memory] (action = record|kill, floor_pct, horizon_s, window_s, min_victim_mib, protect, poll_s, top_n) and [ship] sections, added to TOP_KEYS with validators and documented in config template and explain config; live-reloadable like the rest.

obligations.behavior: every verb takes --json, writes results to stdout and errors to stderr, exits 0/1/2 per _errors.py, and has an explain entry.
obligations.source_text: CLI: noun 'memory' (overview, status, top) and noun 'ship' (overview, test, fetch), each a module with register(sub) wired in _build_parser, listed in overview _VERBS, learn text and JSON, and explain catalog ENTRIES; tests copy tests/test_cli_mesh.py:266-301.

obligations.behavior: no object contains environment variables, credentials, or cmdline values following token/key/secret/password-style flags; cmdlines are truncated to 512 chars.
obligations.source_text: Uploaded evidence must not leak secrets: cmdlines are truncated and redacted (token/key/secret/password-style arguments), environment variables are never captured, and the credentials never leave the signer.
